versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Cost Optimizer Pro: 智能AI成本优化系统.
- Features token budget management, marginal benefit detection, and real-time cost tracking.
- Provides multi-dimensional cost statistics (input/output/cache/search).
- Generates optimization suggestions based on usage patterns.
- Supports configurable budget and warning thresholds.
- Includes integration hooks for cost-saving strategies and session cost state recovery.
